edges.reason: _to is the recipient key used in require(_to != address(0)) and balances[_to].
_value is the amount checked and deducted via SafeMath.sub from balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender selects the balance slot debited in transfer.
balances mapping is read (require) and written in transfer.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the sender balance deduction.
transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
_value is passed as the subtrahend into SafeMath.sub.
_owner indexes balances in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
_from indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
_to is the credit destination in transferFrom.
_value is validated against balance/allowance then deducted with SafeMath.sub.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom writes updated balances.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
_spender is the allowance key in approve.
_value is written unchecked into allowed in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_owner indexes allowed in allowance.
_spender indexes allowed in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
_spender is the spender key in increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the current allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseApproval.
increaseApproval reads and writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseApproval stores the increased allowance.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
_spender is the spender key in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue drives the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseApproval.
decreaseApproval reads and writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval stores the reduced or zeroed allowance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the cached allowance.
local oldValue feeds the comparison and subtraction in decreaseApproval.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the deployer gains privileged control.
Ownable constructor initializes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares the caller msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards mint, restricting token creation to the owner.
onlyOwner guards finishMinting.
newOwner is the target address assigned in transferOwnership.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner variable.
_to is the minted balance recipient key in mint.
_amount is added to totalSupply and balances[_to].
mint increases totalSupply.
mint increases balances[_to].
mint calls SafeMath.add for supply and balance updates.
canMint modifier requires !mintingFinished before minting.
finishMinting permanently sets mintingFinished = true.
_value is validated against the caller balance and subtracted in burn.
msg.sender's balance is burned and copied into local burner.
burn reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
burn writes the reduced balance.
burn reduces totalSupply.
burn calls SafeMath.sub on balance and totalSupply.
local burner = msg.sender is used as the balance mapping key in burn.
ICO constructor deploys a new Token (its constructor runs).
ICO constructor stores the newly deployed Token in the token state variable.
now (block.timestamp) gates the ICO fallback via date_start/date_end, making the window miner-influenceable.
date_start is compared with now in the fallback require.
date_end is compared with now in the fallback require.
hard_cap bounds collected.add(msg.value) in the fallback require.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of token.mint in the fallback.
rate multiplies msg.value to compute the minted amount.
collected is read in the cap require before being updated.
funds_address is read in the fallback as the ETH transfer destination.
Fallback performs an external call token.mint before finalizing its own state.
Fallback performs an external ETH transfer to funds_address.
The token state variable supplies the callee for the external mint call.
funds_address receives msg.value through the external transfer.
Fallback updates collected only after the external calls, breaking checks-effects-interactions.
collected is read and then re-written in the post-call state update.
The post-call update writes the collected state variable.
The state write is sequenced after the external ETH transfer, allowing reentrant contribution accounting abuse.
The collected write is sequenced after the external mint call, extending the reentrancy window.
Fallback calls SafeMath.mul for msg.value.mul(rate).
Fallback calls SafeMath.add for the collected cap check and update.
totalTokens reads the token state variable.
totalTokens returns token.totalSupply().
daysRemaining compares now against date_end, making the result timestamp dependent.
date_end is the timestamp bound used in daysRemaining.
daysRemaining calls SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.div on the remaining time.
collectedEther reads the collected state variable.
collectedEther calls SafeMath.div to convert wei to ether.
Local product c = a * b is computed and asserted inside SafeMath.mul.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only meaningful inside transfer's balance update, so fold it into the enclosing function node.
Amount parameter is consumed solely by transfer's SafeMath.sub/add balance arithmetic.
Lookup key used only for the balances read inside balanceOf.
Source address used only to index balances and allowed within transferFrom.
Recipient address used only for the balance credit inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter used only in transferFrom's balance and allowance arithmetic.
Spender key used only when writing allowed in approve.
Allowance value stored directly by approve with no other use.
Owner key used only for the allowed read inside allowance.
Spender key used only for the allowed read inside allowance.
Spender key used only for the allowance update in increaseApproval.
Increment value consumed only by increaseApproval's SafeMath.add.
Spender key used only for the allowance update in decreaseApproval.
Decrement value consumed only by decreaseApproval's comparison and subtraction.
New owner address is used only to reassign the owner state variable.
Minting recipient used only as the balances key inside mint.
Minted amount consumed only by mint's totalSupply and balances SafeMath.add calls.
Burn amount consumed only by burn's balance and totalSupply deduction.
Intermediate product exists only for the overflow assertion inside SafeMath.mul.
Cached allowance value is local bookkeeping for the decreaseApproval branch.
Local duplicate of msg.sender used only as the burn balance key.
